budget_consumed_minutes.description: Charged incident minutes inside the rolling 30-day window as of the planning date.

budget_reserve_minutes.description: Reserve floor the policy protects inside the SLO budget.

budget_roll_date.description: First date on which the spendable budget covers the planned downtime (ISO date).

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_window.description: First eligible payments-lane session on or after standard package readiness (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the early-access build saves after the budget roll and the calendar are reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Quillstone's confirmed standard and early-access release dates on QSA-2026-118.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered BUDGET_MINUTE that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: charged incident minutes plus the 10-minute reserve floor

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for spendable payments-api error-budget minutes in the 30-day window before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: BUDGET_MINUTE.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing weekend_standard_window, expedite_early_access_build, tonight_with_board_exception.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_quantity.description: planned downtime minutes the QSA-2026-118 fix needs at the current 7-minute restart metering (2 full-pool restarts + 5 minutes validation)

restart_minutes.description: Restart-to-healthy minutes from the current final RESTART-MIN metering, not the stale one.

restarts_required.description: Full-pool restarts the current advisory revision requires (not the withdrawn revision).

selected_lane_window.description: Lane and session used by the selected option, as LANE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered BUDGET_MINUTE after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Quillstone's confirmed standard and early-access release dates on QSA-2026-118.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing charged incident minutes plus the 10-minute reserve floor.

validation_minutes.description: Post-change validation minutes from the service runbook.

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
